Siddharth Khan
Backend Engineer focused on Go systems | Hyderabad, Telangana
siddharth.khan424@example.com | +91 9431955744

Summary
Backend engineer specializing in high-throughput Go services and distributed systems. Experienced in designing and operating microservices with strong observability and messaging patterns to deliver low-latency, resilient platforms. Proven track record of reducing latency and improving reliability through targeted refactors and instrumentation.

Experience

Swiggy — Aug 2025 - Present
Senior Go Developer — Remote
- Designed and implemented a set of Microservices in Go responsible for order routing; improved median request latency by 35% and reduced error rate by 40% after rollout.
- Built Kafka-based event pipelines (Apache Kafka) to decouple order lifecycle events, enabling near-real-time analytics and reducing downstream batch processing by 80%.
- Implemented end-to-end tracing and metrics for Go services, instrumented producers/consumers, and onboarded Prometheus alerts for key SLOs to achieve 99.95% availability.

HCLTech — Apr 2024 - Jul 2025
Go Developer — Onsite
- Developed gRPC services in Go for internal billing and reconciliation flows, increasing throughput by 2.5x and simplifying client integrations.
- Migrated synchronous flows to an event-driven model using Apache Kafka, cutting peak processing time by 60% and improving failure isolation.
- Added Prometheus instrumentation and dashboards to critical services and reduced Mean Time To Detect (MTTD) incidents by 50% through targeted alerts and runbooks.

CartNest — Aug 2022 - Mar 2024
Go Developer — Hybrid
- Implemented gRPC APIs and backend workers in Go for cart persistence and pricing; optimized Postgres queries and lowered average transaction time by 45%.
- Introduced Prometheus metrics across services and set up alerting for resource saturation, which decreased incident recurrence for database contention by 70%.
- Architected Kafka-driven event fan-out for inventory and pricing updates, supporting peak traffic spikes with zero data loss during launches.

Orbit Health — Apr 2018 - Jul 2022
Backend Engineer — Onsite
- Built Microservices in Go that handled patient event streams and appointment workflows; used Apache Kafka for durable event storage and replay, improving data consistency.
- Designed Postgres schemas and indexing strategies for clinical records, reducing query latency for common workflows by 50%.
- Implemented service-level dashboards and Prometheus-based health checks to maintain stable production performance during scaling events.

Projects
- Real-time Order Simulator: Go-based simulator that generates synthetic order events to test Kafka pipelines and service autoscaling; used by team to validate capacity planning.
- Postgres Query Profiler: Small Go tool to analyze slow queries and suggest indexes; reduced several slow endpoints' p95 by ~30% in production trials.
